stemMd: A secreted protein is being made by a human gland cell. Which route correctly describes its movement after synthesis begins?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Rough endoplasmic reticulum → Golgi apparatus → secretory vesicle

explanationMd: A signal sequence directs the growing secretory protein into rough endoplasmic reticulum. Vesicles then carry it to the Golgi for modification and sorting, followed by transport in secretory vesicles to the surface. The order tracks synthesis, processing and delivery.

distractorRationale.d: Secretory proteins do not normally pass through the nucleus in this route.
distractorRationale.c: Human cells lack chloroplasts and this is not the secretory pathway.
distractorRationale.a: This sequence confuses ribosome formation with protein secretion.
distractorRationale.e: Protein trafficking does not convert a protein back into DNA.
